name: ConnectedVehicleServiceAlertDesk
tagline: Turn connected-car alerts into booked workshop jobs – SLA clocks, consent rules and conversion KPIs in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete dealer service desk for OEM connected-vehicle alerts (DTC, service due, 12V/HV battery, tyres, brakes, ADAS): priority triage queue with first-contact SLAs per severity, consent rules with a safety exception, contact attempts, bookings against daily workshop capacity, duplicate detection, per-vehicle history and alert-to-booking conversion KPIs. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, model-driven views or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Priority triage: breached SLA, severity, time left
Contact attempt log with outcomes and max attempts
Booking with 30-minute slots, advisor, site and day capacity
Vehicle health indicator and alert history
Bulk assign, dismiss, export and delete with undo
8 KPI tiles, funnel and advisor performance
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
